services.label: Services
services.title: Websites, AI automations and agents for businesses
services.subtitle: ORDEL builds for small and mid-size businesses the tools that used to be reserved for big companies: a site that brings customers, automations that save hours, and AI agents working for you in the background.
services.metaDescription: ORDEL builds business websites, automations and AI agents that save hours of work every week. Real projects in production, a clear process, and a no-commitment intro call.
intro: I'm Or Delevski, a CTO / VP R&D with 15+ years in software. At ORDEL I point that level of engineering at businesses like yours: no giant vendor, no chain of contractors, one person who owns everything from spec to launch.
Everything on this site was built exactly that way: the site itself, the apps, the dashboards and the agents. If you want live examples before we talk, the case studies and projects are open to read.

services.title: Business websites
services.text: A fast, sharp, Google-ready site in English and Hebrew. Not a template that looks like everyone else's: designed, secured, and written for your customers. Forms, WhatsApp integration and analytics included.

services.title: AI automations and agents
services.text: Anything that repeats in your business can happen by itself: first replies to customers, scheduling, lead management, call summaries and reports. I build agents that plug into the tools you already use, WhatsApp, email and calendar, and work for you 24/7.

services.title: Apps and digital products
services.text: From idea to store: iOS and Android apps, dashboards and SaaS products. I cover the whole path: spec, design, development, testing and launch, and stay available after it ships.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.text: A short WhatsApp or phone chat, no commitment. I learn what the business needs and what is worth building first.

steps.title: A clear proposal
steps.text: You get a written proposal with a price and a timeline. No surprises halfway.

steps.title: Built in stages
steps.text: Updates and previews along the way, so you see the product taking shape and react in time.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.text: After launch I stay available for questions, fixes and improvements.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: Depends on scope. A brochure site can be live in about two weeks; a more complex system takes one to two months. You get an exact timeline in the intro call.
Each project is priced separately, by what the business actually needs. The proposal arrives in writing before we start, and the price does not move mid-way.

faq.q: Do I need a technical background?
faq.a: Not at all. I explain everything in plain language, and you get a product that is easy to operate.
I stay available for maintenance, changes and improvements. The goal is a product that keeps working and improving after it ships.

services.ctaText: Send a WhatsApp message or leave details in the form, and I'll get back to you within one business day.
